name: NFI Distribution Center Breinigsville PA (910 Nestle)

fieldNotes.truckGate: South driveway connects the open trailer yard directly to the public road (Nestle Way) with no barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or checkpoint pinch-point. Eastern access road junctions are likewise open. Yard is an open-access cross-dock trailer lot inside the Liberty Park / Nestle Way industrial complex.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure of any kind found at any entrance across z19/z20 imagery of the south driveway, east access road, or NE drop-yard road.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No truck gate present, so remoteGs is false by definition.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock terminal with loading doors on BOTH long faces (north and south); NFI marketing flyer lists 47 dock doors w/ levelers. Band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive dedicated drop yards: diagonal trailer rows NE of the building, a second cluster to the east, and a row along the south edge — well over 50 parked trailers in the captured imagery.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock layout means inbound and outbound run from physically separate dock banks on opposite (north vs south) building faces.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple open access points to the public road network (south driveway + eastern access road), so entry and exit are not forced through a single controlled point.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved internal staging/parking lot east of the building between the docks and the drop yards.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep internal approach from the public-road driveway across the lot to the dock faces easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single-carriageway driveway; lane count is an estimate from overhead imagery (no on-site Street View of the entrance).
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two open vehicular access points observed (south driveway to Nestle Way + eastern access road); neither is controlled.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~30.5 acres derived (shoelace) from the traced perimeter polygon (building + cross-dock aprons + drop yards + staging); approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimated from drop-yard stall geometry; approximate.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site is rural/edge-of-town but sits within an active large industrial park near I-78, so cellular coverage is likely adequate; flagged as low-confidence inference.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property in any captured imagery.
fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 910 Nestle Way via Google rooftop geocode (40.5673153, -75.6493462) and the NFI/LoopNet profile (cross-dock terminal, 47 dock doors w/ levelers, 51 off-wall trailer parking) — matches the long narrow cross-dock building, NOT the larger single-footprint DC to the NE (the sister site, idx 01). coords field re-centered on the building itself.
